sentences.text: Louis William Tomlinson -LRB- born Louis Troy Austin ; 24 December 1991 -RRB- is an English singer-songwriter and actor .	songwriter	songwriter	actor	actor
He is known as a member of the pop boy band One Direction .	One Direction	One Direction	pop	Pop music
Tomlinson began his career as an actor , initially appearing in ITV drama Fat Friends as an extra .	actor	actor	ITV	ITV (TV network)	Fat Friends	Fat Friends

He also went on to appear in another ITV drama film If I Had You and the BBC drama Waterloo Road .	ITV	ITV (TV network)	If I Had You	If I Had You (film)	BBC	BBC	Waterloo Road	Waterloo Road (TV series)
In 2010 , he became a founding member of One Direction after auditioning as a solo artist on The X Factor .	One Direction	One Direction	The X Factor	The X Factor (UK)
Following the band 's hiatus , Tomlinson released the single `` Just Hold On '' with Steve Aoki in December 2016 .	Just Hold On	Just Hold On	Steve Aoki	Steve Aoki

In 2013 , he was signed as a footballer by Doncaster Rovers of the Football League Championship on a non-contract basis .	Doncaster	Doncaster	Doncaster Rovers	Doncaster Rovers F.C.	Football League Championship	Football League Championship
The same year he also formed his own record label , Triple Strings Ltd. .
He appeared on Debrett 's 2017 list of the most influential people in the UK .
